test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If 2 August 2016 is a Tuesday, then what will the day of the week on 19 October 2020?
solution: Given: **2 August 2016** was Tuesday. Now, 2016 to 2020 = 4 Years (3 Ordinary Year and 1 Leap Year). And, In 4 Years = 1 Leap year and 3 Ordinary Year. So, 1 Leap Year has 2 odd days, And, 3 Ordinary Year has 3 odd days. Total odd days = 2 + 3 = 5.
